resources.string: This system permission lets Mika read and operate what\'s on any screen. Mika uses it only on its own virtual screen to do the tasks you give it, and acts on your main screen only when you hand it a task there.
The app is now on your main screen. Tap “Done” when you\'re finished; if you\'ve already done the whole thing yourself, tap “I did it myself”.
A website sign-in is open in Settings. Tap “Done” there first, then tap “I’ll handle it”.
Couldn’t move the app to the main screen. Tap “I’ll handle it” to try again.
Couldn’t move the app back to Mika’s screen. Try again.
If there’s no answer within %1$d min, Mika will go on without one.
Too late: after %1$d min Mika went on without an answer.
Unlock to see the recipient and content
Higher effort can help with difficult tasks, but may take longer and use more tokens. Default lets the provider decide.
This provider has not listed the available levels. An unsupported choice may cause tasks to fail; choose Default if that happens.
The provider no longer lists the saved level. Choose Default or another level.
Thinking effort also follows the main model. Select a specific model for this role to set its effort separately.
Configure the Doubao speech credentials in Settings › Model › Speech to text.
Saving doesn\'t go online and doesn\'t check access yet. While you hold to talk, audio goes to Volcengine and may be billed. Credentials are encrypted on this phone.
Could not encrypt and save the speech credentials. Try again.
Volcengine speech recognition, with words appearing as you speak. Turn on Speech Recognition 2.0 in Volcengine first; its credentials are separate from chat models.
Words appear as you speak, recognised by a Fun-ASR real-time server you run yourself (serve_realtime_ws.py from the Fun-ASR project), usually on your local network. No account or key needed.
Enter an address like 192.168.1.10:10095 or ws://host:port.
Saving connects once to check the server, without sending audio. While you hold to talk, audio goes to this server. Plain ws:// is not encrypted, so use it only on a network you trust.
Real-time speech recognition from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Bailian), with words appearing as you speak. Use an API key from the same region as the endpoint.
Enter the Model Studio API key
Leave blank to keep the saved key
Saving connects once to check the key, without sending audio. While you hold to talk, audio goes to Alibaba Cloud and is billed by duration. The key is encrypted on this phone.
Set the Bailian API key in Settings › Model › Speech to text.
The service rejected the key. Check the key and that it belongs to the chosen region.
Couldn\'t reach the service. Check the address and that the service is running.
Self-hosted server or Alibaba Cloud Bailian
Without a workspace ID the general endpoint is used.
A workspace ID can only contain letters, digits and hyphens.
